title: Canonical clopen system transport data
statement: Fix a purity datum $P$ [def-pur-conventions], schemes $X,Y,X_i$, a morphism $g:X\to Y$, a compactification $c$ [def-weil-compactifications-refinements], and an open and closed immersion $j:X_i\to X$ [def-weil-open-immersion] [def-weil-closed-immersion], with $g$ quasi-compact [def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. Define the normalized clopen system transport data to consist of the actual strict etale compact-support systems for $c$ and $c\circ j$, their exceptional adjoints, the counit-normalized strict comparison [lem-pur-clopen-counit-adjoint-comparison] and its common-proper-part normalization, and their etale/pro-etale and sequence-site realizations as in [def-pur-clopen-strict-system-comparison]. Retain the canonical underlying restriction/site square, its whiskering with the exceptional comparison, and the corresponding natural isomorphism on all derived sequence systems, with the formula obtained from that square, the strict comparison, and the realization unit. Retain its precomposition with the actual derived integral reduction functor, with the same map formula. The two target direct-image functors are identified, and both compactifications have the same proper factor. Also name the existing exact ordinary completed-module component restriction of [def-pur-open-completed-restriction-data] at its global completed-module category, its pointwise extension to strict towers, and the exact localization of that tower functor. These definitions assert no existence of the transport data. The named ordinary and tower restrictions are those of [def-pur-clopen-completed-tower-restriction]. Use the canonical derived coordinate functors [def-pur-adic-exceptional-system-realization]. Use normalized exact and right-derived site realization [def-pur-adic-derived-site-realization]. Use compact-support and right-adjoint realization [def-pur-adic-support-realization]. The underlying set-valued open restriction is the graph-coprojection-normalized comparison [def-pe-proetale-object-restriction-comparison-data].
